title: Surveying Garsa's Sanctuary
description: Boba Fett and Fennec Shand walk through the streets of Mos Espa, accompanied by Fett's two new Gamorrean enforcers. Fett and Shand discuss the message that he is sending by refusing to be carried into town. Wanting to set a new standard, Fett opts to go on foot. The group ends up at Garsa's Sanctuary to conduct business with its Twi' Lek proprietor, the fashionable Garsa Fwip. As they enter, two employees, who offer to take the pair's helmets for a cleaning, greet them.
